title: Maximum Substrings With Distinct Start
summary: Given a string of lowercase letters, determine the greatest number of substrings that can be formed where each substring begins with a unique letter.
statement: Given a string of lowercase letters, determine the greatest number of substrings that can be formed where each substring begins with a unique letter.
constraints: Partition or select substrings so every chosen substring begins with a different letter.
Each lowercase letter can start at most one chosen substring.
hints: Every selected substring’s first character must be unique, so distinct letters give an upper bound.
Choose a one-character substring at one occurrence of every distinct letter.
The construction reaches the distinct-letter upper bound exactly.
editorial: The construction reaches the distinct-letter upper bound exactly.

tests.explanation: Only a and b can be distinct starting letters, so the maximum is two.
Each of six letters can start its own substring.
